# 10 Render namespace frames, notes and annotations

## Outcome

`renderClassDiagramToSVG` renders the remaining structural elements: namespace frames behind their
member classes, note boxes with their connectors, and each class's annotation line.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each namespace renders one `<g class="siren-namespace" data-siren-id="{id}">` containing a
  `<rect class="siren-namespace-frame">` and a `<text class="siren-namespace-label">`, appearing
  **before** its member classes in document order so it paints behind them.
- [ ] Each note renders one `<g class="siren-note" data-siren-id="{id}">` with a
  `<rect class="siren-note-frame">` and a `<text class="siren-note-text">`; an attached note also
  renders a `<path class="siren-note-link">`, a free note does not.
- [ ] A class with an annotation renders a `<text class="siren-class-annotation">` above its name;
  one without renders none.
- [ ] A class name carrying a generic renders the generic as part of the name text.
- [ ] Note and annotation text via `textContent` only.
- [ ] Everything from ticket 05 still holds — its tests pass unmodified.


- [ ] Any `siren-*` class you newly emit has a matching rule in `theme/default.css`. The coverage
  test in `theme/default.test.ts` (added by ticket 16, which now runs before this one) fails
  otherwise — that guard exists precisely so a new class cannot ship unthemed, which is how the
  sequence board shipped an invisible diagram.

## Test seam

`renderClassDiagramToSVG(diagram): SVGSVGElement` — component test under jsdom, extending ticket
05's test file.

## Write ownership

- `packages/core/src/renderer/renderClassDiagramToSVG.ts`
- `packages/core/src/renderer/renderClassDiagramToSVG.test.ts`

- `packages/core/src/theme/default.css` (only if you emit a new `siren-*` class)
